```{r}

# ============================================================
# GRAPH 6: EDUCATION EQUALITY VS. LIFE EXPECTANCY
# Interactive Bar Graph | DATA 101 Capstone
# Sources: V-Dem and World Bank
# ============================================================


# 1. LOAD PACKAGES

library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)


# 2. LOAD DATA

files <- list.files(
  ".",
  pattern = "^wdi_clean\\.csv$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(files) == 0) {
  files <- list.files(
    "~",
    pattern = "^wdi_clean\\.csv$",
    recursive = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE
  )
}

if (length(files) == 0) {
  stop("Could not find wdi_clean.csv.")
}

data <- read_csv(files[1], show_col_types = FALSE)


# 3. CLEAN DATA

graph_data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year),
    educ_equality = as.numeric(educ_equality),
    life_expect = as.numeric(life_expect),
    country = as.character(country),
    region = as.character(region)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(year),
    !is.na(country),
    !is.na(region),
    !is.na(iso3c),
    is.finite(educ_equality),
    is.finite(life_expect),
    life_expect > 0,
    life_expect <= 110
  ) %>%
  distinct(iso3c, year, .keep_all = TRUE)


# 4. DEFAULT SETTINGS

available_years <- sort(unique(graph_data$year))

default_year <- if (2022 %in% available_years) {
  2022
} else {
  max(available_years)
}

edu_limits <- c(
  floor(min(graph_data$educ_equality) * 10) / 10,
  ceiling(max(graph_data$educ_equality) * 10) / 10
)

life_axis_max <- 110

group_levels <- c(
  "Lower Equality",
  "Middle Equality",
  "Higher Equality"
)

group_colors <- c(
  "Lower Equality" = "#E57373",
  "Middle Equality" = "#FFB74D",
  "Higher Equality" = "#64B5F6"
)


# ============================================================
# 5. USER INTERFACE
# ============================================================

ui <- fluidPage(

  titlePanel(
    "Education Equality and Life Expectancy"
  ),

  p(
    "Explore how equality in educational opportunities
     is associated with life expectancy across countries."
  ),

  sidebarLayout(

    sidebarPanel(

      # YEAR

      sliderInput(
        "year",
        "Select Year:",
        min = min(available_years),
        max = max(available_years),
        value = default_year,
        step = 1,
        sep = ""
      ),

      # REGION

      selectInput(
        "region",
        "Select Region:",
        choices = c(
          "All Regions",
          sort(unique(graph_data$region))
        ),
        selected = "All Regions"
      ),

      # EDUCATION EQUALITY RANGE

      sliderInput(
        "education_range",
        "Education Equality Range:",
        min = edu_limits[1],
        max = edu_limits[2],
        value = edu_limits,
        step = 0.1
      ),

      # LIFE EXPECTANCY AXIS

      sliderInput(
        "y_range",
        "Life Expectancy Y-Axis Range:",
        min = 0,
        max = life_axis_max,
        value = c(0, 100),
        step = 5
      ),

      # MEAN OR MEDIAN

      radioButtons(
        "statistic",
        "Choose Statistic:",
        choices = c("Mean", "Median"),
        selected = "Mean",
        inline = TRUE
      ),

      # COUNTRY DOTS

      checkboxInput(
        "show_points",
        "Show Individual Countries",
        value = TRUE
      ),

      # RESET

      actionButton(
        "reset",
        "Reset Filters"
      ),

      hr(),

      strong("Data Sources"),

      p("Education Equality: V-Dem"),

      p("Life Expectancy: World Bank"),

      p(
        "Countries are divided into three equally
         sized groups based on education equality
         within the selected year and region."
      )
    ),

    mainPanel(

      plotlyOutput(
        "education_barplot",
        height = "550px"
      ),

      h4("Summary Statistics"),

      tableOutput("summary_table"),

      br(),

      strong(textOutput("country_count")),

      textOutput("correlation_text"),

      textOutput("difference_text"),

      br(),

      p(
        "Note: This graph shows an association,
         not a causal relationship."
      )
    )
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 6. SERVER
# ============================================================

server <- function(input, output, session) {


  # 6A. FILTER DATA

  filtered_data <- reactive({

    df <- graph_data %>%
      filter(
        year == input$year,
        educ_equality >= input$education_range[1],
        educ_equality <= input$education_range[2]
      )

    if (input$region != "All Regions") {
      df <- df %>%
        filter(region == input$region)
    }

    if (nrow(df) < 3) {
      return(df)
    }

    # Rank countries by education equality
    # and divide into three groups.

    df <- df %>%
      mutate(
        group_number = ntile(educ_equality, 3),

        Education_Group = factor(
          group_number,
          levels = 1:3,
          labels = group_levels
        )
      )

    df
  })


  # 6B. CALCULATE SUMMARY STATISTICS

  summary_data <- reactive({

    df <- filtered_data()

    req(nrow(df) >= 3)

    df %>%
      group_by(Education_Group) %>%
      summarise(
        Countries = n_distinct(iso3c),

        Mean_Life = mean(life_expect),

        Median_Life = median(life_expect),

        Min_Life = min(life_expect),

        Max_Life = max(life_expect),

        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Display_Value = if (
          input$statistic == "Mean"
        ) {
          Mean_Life
        } else {
          Median_Life
        },

        Hover = paste0(
          "<b>", Education_Group, "</b>",
          "<br>Countries: ", Countries,
          "<br>Mean Life Expectancy: ",
          round(Mean_Life, 2), " years",
          "<br>Median Life Expectancy: ",
          round(Median_Life, 2), " years",
          "<br>Minimum: ",
          round(Min_Life, 2), " years",
          "<br>Maximum: ",
          round(Max_Life, 2), " years"
        )
      )
  })


  # ==========================================================
  # 7. INTERACTIVE BAR GRAPH
  # ==========================================================

  output$education_barplot <- renderPlotly({

    df <- filtered_data()

    validate(
      need(
        nrow(df) >= 6,
        "Not enough countries for this selection."
      )
    )

    bars <- summary_data()

    # Create Plotly graph directly to avoid
    # the ggplotly quosure error.

    p <- plot_ly()

    # Add bars

    p <- p %>%
      add_bars(
        x = as.character(bars$Education_Group),
        y = bars$Display_Value,

        text = bars$Hover,
        hoverinfo = "text",

        marker = list(
          color = unname(
            group_colors[
              as.character(bars$Education_Group)
            ]
          )
        ),

        width = 0.6,

        name = "Life Expectancy",

        showlegend = FALSE
      )

    # Add value labels

    p <- p %>%
      add_text(
        x = as.character(bars$Education_Group),
        y = bars$Display_Value,

        text = sprintf(
          "%.1f",
          bars$Display_Value
        ),

        textposition = "top center",

        textfont = list(
          size = 13,
          color = "#222222"
        ),

        hoverinfo = "skip",
        showlegend = FALSE
      )

    # Add individual country observations

    if (input$show_points) {

      df <- df %>%
        mutate(
          Hover = paste0(
            "<b>", country, "</b>",
            "<br>Region: ", region,
            "<br>Year: ", year,
            "<br>Education Equality: ",
            round(educ_equality, 2),
            "<br>Life Expectancy: ",
            round(life_expect, 2),
            " years"
          )
        )

      # Jitter points horizontally so they overlap less.
      # Set seed for reproducibility.

      set.seed(101)

      df <- df %>%
        mutate(
          group_position = as.numeric(
            Education_Group
          ),

          jitter_position = group_position +
            runif(n(), -0.19, 0.19)
        )

      p <- p %>%
        add_markers(
          x = df$jitter_position,
          y = df$life_expect,

          text = df$Hover,
          hoverinfo = "text",

          marker = list(
            size = 7,
            color = "#202020",
            opacity = 0.55,
            line = list(
              color = "white",
              width = 0.5
            )
          ),

          name = "Countries",
          showlegend = FALSE
        )
    }

    # Use numeric x-axis positions for both bars and dots.
    # Rebuild with numeric positions to ensure alignment.

    p <- plot_ly()

    p <- p %>%
      add_bars(
        x = seq_len(nrow(bars)),
        y = bars$Display_Value,

        text = bars$Hover,
        hoverinfo = "text",

        marker = list(
          color = unname(
            group_colors[
              as.character(bars$Education_Group)
            ]
          )
        ),

        width = 0.65,
        showlegend = FALSE
      )

    p <- p %>%
      add_text(
        x = seq_len(nrow(bars)),
        y = bars$Display_Value,

        text = sprintf(
          "%.1f",
          bars$Display_Value
        ),

        textposition = "top center",
        hoverinfo = "skip",
        showlegend = FALSE
      )

    if (input$show_points) {

      p <- p %>%
        add_markers(
          x = df$jitter_position,
          y = df$life_expect,

          text = df$Hover,
          hoverinfo = "text",

          marker = list(
            size = 7,
            color = "#222222",
            opacity = 0.55
          ),

          showlegend = FALSE
        )
    }

    # Final layout

    p %>%
      layout(

        title = list(
          text = paste0(
            input$statistic,
            " Life Expectancy by Education Equality (",
            input$year,
            ")"
          )
        ),

        xaxis = list(
          title = "Education Equality Group",

          tickmode = "array",

          tickvals = 1:3,

          ticktext = group_levels,

          range = c(0.45, 3.55)
        ),

        yaxis = list(
          title = "Life Expectancy (Years)",

          range = input$y_range,

          autorange = FALSE,

          zeroline = TRUE
        ),

        bargap = 0.35,

        hovermode = "closest",

        margin = list(
          t = 90,
          b = 90,
          l = 75,
          r = 30
        )
      )
  })


  # ==========================================================
  # 8. SUMMARY TABLE
  # ==========================================================

  output$summary_table <- renderTable({

    df <- filtered_data()

    validate(
      need(
        nrow(df) >= 3,
        "Not enough countries."
      )
    )

    summary_data() %>%
      transmute(
        `Education Equality Group` = Education_Group,

        Countries,

        `Mean Life Expectancy` = round(
          Mean_Life, 2
        ),

        `Median Life Expectancy` = round(
          Median_Life, 2
        )
      )

  }, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE)


  # ==========================================================
  # 9. COUNTRY COUNT
  # ==========================================================

  output$country_count <- renderText({

    paste(
      "Countries displayed:",
      n_distinct(filtered_data()$iso3c)
    )
  })


  # ==========================================================
  # 10. PEARSON CORRELATION
  # ==========================================================

  output$correlation_text <- renderText({

    df <- filtered_data()

    if (
      nrow(df) < 3 ||
      sd(df$educ_equality) == 0 ||
      sd(df$life_expect) == 0
    ) {
      return("Pearson correlation unavailable.")
    }

    r <- cor(
      df$educ_equality,
      df$life_expect,
      use = "complete.obs"
    )

    paste0(
      "Pearson correlation (r): ",
      round(r, 3)
    )
  })


  # ==========================================================
  # 11. DIFFERENCE BETWEEN HIGHEST AND LOWEST GROUP
  # ==========================================================

  output$difference_text <- renderText({

    df <- filtered_data()

    if (nrow(df) < 6) {
      return("")
    }

    bars <- summary_data()

    low <- bars$Display_Value[
      bars$Education_Group == "Lower Equality"
    ]

    high <- bars$Display_Value[
      bars$Education_Group == "Higher Equality"
    ]

    if (length(low) == 0 || length(high) == 0) {
      return("")
    }

    difference <- high - low

    paste0(
      "Difference between higher and lower ",
      "education equality groups: ",
      round(difference, 2),
      " years (",
      tolower(input$statistic),
      " life expectancy)."
    )
  })


  # ==========================================================
  # 12. RESET FILTERS
  # ==========================================================

  observeEvent(input$reset, {

    updateSliderInput(
      session,
      "year",
      value = default_year
    )

    updateSelectInput(
      session,
      "region",
      selected = "All Regions"
    )

    updateSliderInput(
      session,
      "education_range",
      value = edu_limits
    )

    updateSliderInput(
      session,
      "y_range",
      value = c(0, 100)
    )

    updateRadioButtons(
      session,
      "statistic",
      selected = "Mean"
    )

    updateCheckboxInput(
      session,
      "show_points",
      value = TRUE
    )
  })

}


# ============================================================
# 13. LAUNCH APPLICATION
# ============================================================

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

```
